verdict.rationale: LibreChat's MCP docs explicitly name web browsers among the tools agents can be extended with ([librechat-docs-7], [librechat-docs-24]), so browser control is a documented, supported path. That capability comes from plugging in an external MCP server rather than a first-party browser tool, and nothing documents navigating, logging in, clicking, or extracting from live pages. Web Search is an adjacent feature, not browser automation. Missing for 10: a first-party browser-automation tool, documented navigate/login/click/extract workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
